【原视频简介】
Claude Fable 5.1 just dropped, and I’m putting it to work immediately. The new model is aimed heavily at coding, knowledge work, computer use, and agentic workflows—and some of the early benchmark jumps over Fable 5 and Opus 5 are pretty wild.

In this video, I break down the new benchmarks and then actually TEST Fable 5.1 by having it build:

🔥 A Windows 2000-inspired interactive desktop
🔥 A complete Tech2Wild website from scratch
🔥 A 3D voxel simulation
🔥 Coding, design, and agentic-style workflows

And the results got way more interesting than I expected. The website even pulled together information around my hardware, repos, models, benchmarks, and Tech2Wild content.

I also talk about where Fable 5.1 could fit inside my AI agent stack, how it compares to Opus 5, and whether frontier cloud models are striking back after local models like DeepSeek and GLM have been absolutely killing it lately.

Is Fable 5.1 actually better than Opus 5? And is this enough to keep me using Claude?

Subscribe for more Local AI, DGX Spark, RTX 3090, open-model deployments, agents, benchmarks, and real-world AI testing.
